about: The same program as `feed-modes.json`, on a machine whose power-on feed mode is G95. Nothing in the program says so, so the difference is visible only where the state is assumed — and it is marked with where it came from (AD-19 rule 8, AD-31). This is the case that proves a machine, and not the dialect, decides the power-on state.

states.about: Assumed, and from the machine — not from the profile's documented G94.
Still assumed: the program has written nothing but comments and a program number.
The safety line writes G94, and what the program writes always wins over the power-on state.
